description:
Optimizes logging performance across the codebase by caching static values at module load, adding early log level filtering, and eliminating repeated dictionary allocations in hot paths.

Closes #1657 

### Changes

**`mcpgateway/services/structured_logger.py`**
- Cache `hostname` and `pid` at module load instead of calling `socket.gethostname()` and `os.getpid()` on every log entry
- Move OpenTelemetry import to module level with availability flag to avoid import overhead per log
- Add `_should_log()` helper for early termination before expensive enrichment/DB operations

**`mcpgateway/services/logging_service.py`**
- Cache `hostname` and `pid` at module load
- Move three level-mapping dictionaries to module-level constants:
  - `_PYTHON_TO_MCP_LEVEL_MAP` (used in `StorageHandler.emit()`)
  - `_MCP_TO_PYTHON_METHOD_MAP` (used in `notify()`)
  - `_MCP_LEVEL_VALUES` (used in `_should_log()`)
- Properly set root logger level from `settings.log_level`

**`mcpgateway/middleware/request_logging_middleware.py`**
- Add `log_request_start` parameter (default: `False`) to optionally skip "request started" logs
- When disabled, reduces middleware logging overhead by ~50% (1 log vs 2 per request)

### Performance Impact

| Optimization | Benefit |
|-------------|---------|
| Cached hostname/PID | Eliminates 2 system calls per log entry |
| Module-level OTEL import | Eliminates import check per log entry |
| Early log level filtering | Skips enrichment/DB writes for filtered logs |
| Cached level mapping dicts | Eliminates 3 dict allocations per log entry |
| Optional request start log | Halves middleware logging overhead |

**Estimated improvement at 1000 logs/sec:**
- ~10-20 MB/day less GC pressure from eliminated object allocations
- Reduced p99 latency from fewer system calls in hot paths
